ns2:course.label: Physical Biochemistry
ns2:course.description: Physical properties of biological macromolecules, with special emphasis on proteins and nucleic acids; the use of physical methods for the characterization of such substances. Same as CHEM 472 and MCB 446. Prerequisite: CHEM 440 or CHEM 444; MCB 354 or MCB 450 or equivalent is recommended.
